page.overview:
Who is Sara Safestreet?

Sara Safestreet is a character in the 2011 State Farm commercial. She is a State Farm Insurance agent.

In the commercial Mater, Holley Shiftwell, and Finn McMissile are driving through a street. Mater then gets cocky and drives backwards without looking at his rearview mirrors. He then crashes into a pole which crashes into a pet store window, causing the miniature planes, trains and micro-cars to escape. Sara shows up and honks the State Farm jingle. Then, almost a dozen State Farm Insurance Pitties show up and clean up the mess.
